tagline: An open source AI agent platform: bots across messengers, real-time voice calls, and encryption whose key belongs to you alone.
disclaimer: AiR is an open source project. The subscription pays for server resources and the developer's work, not for AI provider tokens — those are paid directly to the provider with your own keys. Donations are voluntary and grant no additional features.
